definition: to show that something is true by demonstrating it
description: A 3D-animated young woman faces a doubting friend who stands with crossed arms. She kicks up into a perfect handstand, holds it while his face turns from smug to amazed, then lands; he applauds and admits she won.
transcript: No way! Okay, okay, you win.
